hooks.name: Spec Sync Reminder on DOM Changes
hooks.description: Remind agent to verify .kiro/specs/stacks-core/tasks.md is accurate when DOM layer files are modified

action.prompt: A DOM file was just saved (src/dom/). If significant UI changes were made, check if .kiro/specs/stacks-core/tasks.md needs updating. Review related spec tasks to ensure they still match the implementation.
